group.p: Ordinary values only. Values are visible in approved scripts and audit history; do not store secrets.

Reference variables as "${DEPLOY_MODULES}". Names must start with DEPLOY_ and use uppercase letters, digits or underscores. Missing referenced values block submission. DEPLOY_ references in comments and literal text are also checked.

Automatic server variables: DEPLOY_DATABASE, DEPLOY_PYTHON, DEPLOY_CONFIG, DEPLOY_SERVER_PATH, DEPLOY_LOG_PATH and DEPLOY_ODOO_BIN (Odoo Server Path + /server/odoo-bin). These names cannot be overridden.
